prompt: You finish a draft of a short story and want feedback that will actually help you improve it. Which request is most likely to get a useful response?

options.text: Could you tell me whether the opening paragraph makes you want to keep reading, and why?
Please only correct every spelling mistake
Tell me honestly whether I have talent

explanation: A specific question about one part of the work gives the reader something concrete to answer, and the reasons they give point to changes you can actually make.
